title: Vibra diagnostic
description: One structured diagnostic as rendered to JSON by the CLI and MCP surfaces. Spans are half-open UTF-8 byte ranges; line and column are derived display data.

schemaVersion.description: Major version of this contract. A reader must reject a newer major version it cannot interpret rather than guessing.

level.description: The level registered for this code. Fixed by the specification and not configurable by a project.

message.description: Human-facing text. Tests assert codes, levels, and spans rather than this wording.

related.description: Additional spans that explain the diagnostic.

fixes.description: Fixes offered for this diagnostic. Present only for a code whose registered fix capability is @safe.

diagnosticCode.description: A stable lowercase atom of the form @<domain>.<thing>, both components kebab-case.

position.description: A one-based display position. The column counts Unicode scalar values.

span.description: A half-open UTF-8 byte range, with its endpoints also given as derived display positions.

fix.description: A fix descriptor. Edits belong to a transactional edit plan, not to a diagnostic.

safe.description: Whether the fix may be applied without review. Only a safe fix is applied by `vibra edit fix`.

expectedRevision.description: The document revision the fix was computed against. An apply against a different revision is rejected.
